company_info.company_description: "At Traeger Solar we are experts in solar and battery systems and we only use the highest quality products. This, combined with our expert in-house installation technicians, enable us to deliver superior results for our customers.Traeger Solar will guide you through the entire process from the initial site consultation, through to commissioning your solar and/or battery system, whilst ensuring all documentation is submitted to the appropriate distributor."

reviews.review_description: Aaron and team were great from quote through to installation of a Battery system for our home. Would highly recommend and really easy to deal with and very helpful.

Aaron and the team were professional and great! We had a 10kw of solar panels installed with 24kwh Sigenergy batteries! The team were clean, tidy and extremely punctual! Everything was handled by Aaron and team with the booking of the inspector after installation to the arranging of the rebates. 2 Day install process for both the battery and the panels.

Aaron and the team from Traeger Solar made the installation of our 10KW solar panel system a straightforward and smooth process.Aaron is very knowledgeable, and his whole team were great to deal with.  The install was fast (completed in 2 days) and we have been very pleased with the results. I highly recommend Traeger Solar

Great quotes and install from Traeger solar.  Easy to contact replied promptly, small company just the 5 but install went in without incident and the system sigenergy working better than anticipated by myself or the installer. 2 day install, nice and clean up after finished.

Aaron was the only person to come to site to review the options.  I didn't rush into the process and he was not pushy.  We discussed various options and he let me know the pro's and con's.Was not the cheapest but I got a good sense that they would be a quality installer.Once I agreed on a solution, his team was available in a couple of weeks but he brought that forward (assuming a cancelation).  Installation took a day and half.  I couldn't fault the work and they cleaned up after themselves.  Team is was friendly and explained how the system works.Highly recommend

Highly recommend Traeger Solar. Great family business; Aaron knows his stuff. Aaron Traeger who later installed the system personally came on-site to quote, was friendly and not at all pushy; unlike some other companies I didn’t need to deal with un-knowledgeable sales staff and pushy sales tactics. Also unlike some other companies I wasn’t expected to pay a huge amount upfront, or pay the full amount and have the rebate reimbursed later. The price was also much cheaper than the competition (I guess not needing to pay Sales staff?) and for the same price as others had quoted for a 16kwh battery I was unexpectedly able to double it with Traeger Solar and get a 32kwh battery! Given now is a busy time for solar and battery installations, Aaron gave realistic timelines and then beat them. He and the other installers were professional, respectful, and cleaned everything up well. Aaron is understandably a busy person with lots of work booked in, but it’s well worth the wait to get Traeger Solar to install your system.

I contacted SolarQuotes for three quotes and ended up working with Aaron from Traeger Solar. From the outset, he took the time to really understand my needs and concerns, presenting a range of options with detailed recommendations—including a surprisingly affordable battery-equipped system.Throughout the decision-making process, Aaron was incredibly patient, answering my constant stream of questions thoroughly. He reviewed the design I had in mind, matched competitor pricing, and offered thoughtful advice without any pressure to upsell.Initially, I wasn’t planning to include a battery, but I was curious about the cost and feasibility. I ultimately chose Aaron’s recommendation: a 16kWh Sigenergy battery system paired with a 19kW solar array. At no point did he try to push a more expensive setup—in fact, he advised that I didn’t really need such a large system.Then, just before installation, the new government battery rebate was announced. To take advantage of it, I decided to add three more 8kWh batteries, bringing my total storage capacity to 40kWh.Aaron’s team was punctual, respectful, and worked seamlessly together. The atmosphere was always positive, even with me nearby asking plenty of questions—they never showed frustration.This was Aaron’s first time installing a Sigenergy system, and I had complete confidence in him. He didn’t disappoint. The installation took three days due to my complex, shaded roof, but the work was done with great care and attention to detail.Today (July 2nd), Aaron returned to complete the commissioning and even made several upgrades at no extra charge. This included installing an awning over the batteries and replacing all of my circuit breakers to ensure they met current safety standards for battery systems.I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Traeger Solar to anyone considering solar. Aaron and his team went above and beyond

Sales quoting process was well documented and easy to follow. The installation went smoothly and was started a week earlier than expected. All staff were very friendly and left the site clean. Aaron has provided great customer service post installation and has organised grid connection.

Quoting was done well; the supplier came at looked at our situation.The installation was quick . they were polite & considerate. They cleaned up after themselves. They came when they said they would.The grid connection was organised & was implemented just over a week of the installation.What is the charger?They sent me the information for installing the current power outputs & usage, etc. The installation process was a bit clunky...I would have liked to see a cumulative version of that information...I requested a 10 kW set, but have not seen any output over 4 kWs (& that once only), even on a sunny day...

Aaron asked to have a look tab the property prior to submitting a quote.  When visiting he was very knowledgeable, answered all questions and explained the process.  He submitted a quote taking my observations into account and modified the quote based a further discussions.Installation was tidy, and professional.  Everything was organised, ie connection to grid, obtaining interest free loans and subsidies.

Aaron was very efficient at doing all the paperwork and getting everything ready in record time. He is the only installer that actually came on site to look at the job before quoting. He has a great team. Installing 60 panels on a large shed, is not a one-man-job. They all know what they're doing, and they don't cut corners. Their price is very competitive. I wouldn't consider going elsewhere, now that I know what it is like working with Aaron.

Traeger Solar provided a seamless service from end to end. After attending my home to survey the installation issues and explaining the process Aaron then provided a quote and all the information needed for me to continue the process. Our approval was very quick and Aaron was able to fit our installation in within a week. The installation team were very efficient, particularly given they were working in very hot conditions, and completed the task with no mess afterwards. Aaron even supplied additional tiles when it was noticed that some were already cracked before they commenced.I would highly recommend Traeger Solar.

Aaron and his team did a great job installing our 10kW system with a PV point.We chose Aaron based on the recommendations from our neighbours, and he lived up to our expectations throughout the process. Aaron visited our home to check and advise before quoting, and we had smooth communication until everything was set up.It was a nice and clean installation with quality components at the end of the day.

I received 3 quotes & decided to pick the cheapest, only because we are pensioners & probably not got the years to recoup the expenditure like younger people!!!  I can't fault the 3 installers.  They were polite & helpful & explained what was happening.  They organised the grid connection & put an app on my mobile phone. I would certainly recommend the firm.

Aaron provided a seamless transition to solar.He answered all questions I had throughout the process promptly.Including secondary system quotes.Install team arrived on time, installed during terrible weather and left the install area super clean.Post install queries with connection to United energy were explained in terms a novice could understand.Fully enjoying my Ferrari of a system now!

Doing an install for a mostly retired electrical contractor and an ex installer is a tuff gig. I contacted Solar Quotes and Aaron made contact and an appointment very soon after. I had thoughts of micro inverters, optimisers and fronius systems, all with batteries. I wanted a quality and efficient system and in the end I let Aaron choose what would be best.A month after the system energized, I can reflect good decisions on both the installer and system. Aaron's team of Luke, Calum and Corey were excellent. My wife commented later how they communicated with each other in such a friendly manner.Ours was not a straight forward install with the main switchboard inside a mud brick house. However it has turned out to be a very neat job. After four weeks we have used just under 2 kwh's. Self sufficiently can be achieved. Great job.

QuotationAaron was able to break down and explain preferred products to me in a quick and simple manner. A proposal was provided to me in a few hours allowing me to make a decision on the same day.InstallationAfter accepting the quote, Aaron was able to book the installation a week from our initial phone call (which I was thrilled with). Aaron and his team were very easy to deal with, they arrived on time (7:30 am) and I was told the estimated completion time would be approximately 3 pm. They explained the chances of roof tile damage due to the type of tiles I had but ended up not damaging any. The day also had sporadic rain but the team persisted and completed the install almost 2 hours earlier than expected.ServiceUpon install the team showed me how to run the inverter and the app and spoke to me about what to expect the next couple of days. I did notice that the hole behind the inverter was not sealed with silicon (something to check before the installers leave) however I see this as an easy thing to remedy and does not affect their rating. Aaron organised the inspection of the system of which I was told would be within the next 5-7 business days, however the inspector came the day after install. This meant we had the system operating just over a week after I was provided with a quote (super thrilled about this). Aaron also contacted the energy provider for me and had the excess generated solar being registered by my energy company a week after the installation.I understand that Aaron is pretty busy, he did not answer a few of my text queries but always picked up my phone calls which was great on his side.Definitely give the entire experience A+ and would recommend Traeger Solar to anyone else.
Yet again, Aaron was terrific. Reached out to him again when installing an EV charger (previously installed my solar). Installation was quick and tidy.

Aaron was very professional, giving a clear estimate then following up with a site visit and a firm quote. The project went ahead, without a hitch, a couple of weeks later. Luke who led the on-site team ( under Aaron's direct supervision) was very capable, courteous and helpful. He and Aaron were great to deal with every helpful.I highly recommend them. They installed quickly and professionally, did a fine job and cleaned up carefully, on leaving. I wish everyone I have dealt with in the last 40 yrs was so capable. Thank you, Finn, for referring them.

Aaron was terrific throughout the quotation process - punctual to do the site visit, patiently explained the reasons for his recommended layout of the panels and choice of inverter and was very accommodating about the payment terms.Traeger Solar's quote was the most competitive for exactly the same brand of panels, system size and inverter so given the above, it was an easy choice to make and go with Aaron and his team.  And the installation was scheduled within 3 weeks of accepting the quote!!The day before the scheduled installation date, Aaron and his team turned up to set up the scaffolding, and the following day the job was done by 3pm!!!  Luke helped with the Wi-Fi and network setup and patiently talked me through the whole login process and inverter functions.  And the place was left neat and tidy.Incidentally, the Traeger installation team did a great job of tidying up the connection from the inverter to the junction box - the previous solar panel inverter connection was a quick-and easy one by comparison, but I didn't know the difference 16 years back!!!The inspection and commissioning happened two days later - super fast!! - and so far, touch wood, everything is functioning as promised - and Aaron has been very quick to respond to a few queries that I had in the first few days.I would highly recommend Aaron and Traeger Solar.

Traegar Solar were very professional, from the time they made contact, quoted, responded to questions, and did the install.No problems occurred, and system was in and running within 2 days.Aaron really understands his business.
What a wonderful process to have our new system installed. Right from the first contact to get a quote, through to completion, everything went smoothly. A great team.

Aaron was very professional, punctual and efficient.We had a fairly straightforward install on a tin roof with easy access (incredibly poor internal ancess though!) and his crew was finished in under 5 hours.I really appreciated his attention to detail, including small things like a bit of cardboard under the ladder against the fascia and lining conduit up with screw lines.I chose Aaron because he is the one that does the quote and the install, he doesn’t subcontract out after winning the job. He took the time to give me advice, and answer my questionsBasically I paid him and we’re connected with solar. He organised everything including notifying our power company. The only thing I had to do separately is apply online for the vic solar rebate.

Aaron was the only installer who offered to come to my house to confirm the design of the solar array. By taking actual measurement on my roof he was able to create the best design in terms of panel orientation, as well as maximising the number of panels. By visiting house, we could also discuss the best location of the inverter and Aaron explained to me where the cabling would run.Aaron was also able to schedule the installation the fastest.The installation went very smoothly with the team being there on time, very professional, very efficient, keeping me informed of adjustement they had to make along the way.They helped me get started with the sungrow monitoring application, and explained how to shut down the system while waiting for the independent inspection one week later.Inspection went very smoothly and the system has been running well ever since.I will recommend Trager solar to all my friends who are considering starting their solar journey.

I previously engaged Traeger Solar to install a 6.6kW system at my family home - you can see my review from November 2019 here on SolarQuotes. When lightning struck the NBN box in my front yard and took out the network card of the Fronius inverter (amongst other things!), Traeger Solar were happy to assist in arranging assessment and replacement of the damaged parts to get the system back up-and-running.Since 2019, I have happily recommended Traeger Solar to many friends and family members, as I trust Aaron and his team's high standard of workmanship and after-sales care.I have just finished building a brand new home in a new estate in Melbourne's outer-eastern suburbs, so it was only natural to reach out to Traeger Solar to fit solar for my new home.I engaged Aaron early on in my build, ensuring that my home had three-phase power and helping to make it solar-ready right from the frame stage. I also worked closely with my builder to ensure roof penetrations (whirly bird, etc.) were kept out the way of where solar PV panels would be located, so as to allow the maximum number of panels and a good-looking installation.Being in a leafy area where storm damage can take out the power for several days at a time, I was concerned about losing the contents of my fridge and freezer. Unfortunately, I lack the budget for a solar battery.Aaron provided me with a quote for three different 12kW system options, and this quote included an option for the Fronius GEN24 Plus inverter, which features the "PV Point": an integrated basic backup power supply (10A/2.2kW) from a socket as long as the sun is shining - even when the grid is down.This allows me to run an extension cable from my fridge to the PV Point, ensuring my food remains safe whilst also allowing me to boil the kettle or recharge my phone/laptop battery during the day. No solar battery required!!Installation went super smoothly – Aaron and his team turned up first thing in the morning and were done before 3pm. They were neat, tidy, and cleaned up their mess. All the inverter cables are neatly concealed behind the plaster, so the fit and finish is fantastic. The electrical safety inspection was completed promptly (the inspector noted to me that Traeger Solar's work is consistently excellent), and paperwork was lodged with my retailer for the meter reconfiguration without hassle.My 12.3kW system has produced as much as 33kWh on a late-May sunny winter's day, and 30.7kWh on the day before the Winter Solstice (shortest day of the year) – very impressive numbers which will only get better in summer time, and already saving me heaps on my electricity bill.Overall, I am super pleased with Aaron's work and will continue to recommend Traeger Solar to others.

Aaron, who owns the company,  visited my house promptly after contact to assess and discuss solar. He then proposed two options arising from that discussion. By visiting he was able to assess best panel location after looking at nearby trees, shading, orientation etc. Having been solar converts for some time and “ knowing the ropes” we just went with a larger array of better panels and a new quality inverter to replace our much smaller 15yr old system that was coming off the premium feed in tariff. Other companies quoted using aerial photos and I didn’t like that and I felt like I was dealing with a salesman rather than installer.  Aaron helped in facilitating the government rebate process with his digital quoting system and kept me up to date with email and phone.The installers were polite, neat and efficient and left zero mess. We had to have our switchboard updated in addition and this was organised to be done same day as install. The inspector came the afternoon of install and our system was up and running by the end of the day. All pretty seamless really. One of the fellas also helped me out with another small electrical job after they had finished the install.  Thoroughly recommend.

Aaron, who owns the company, visited my house promptly after contact to assess and discuss solar. He then proposed two options arising from that discussion. By visiting he was able to assess best panel location after looking at nearby trees, shading, orientation etc. Having been solar converts for some time and “ knowing the ropes” we just went with a larger array of better panels and a new quality inverter to replace our much smaller 15yr old system that was coming off the premium feed in tariff. Other companies quoted using aerial photos and I didn’t like that and I felt like I was dealing with a salesman rather than installer.  Aaron helped in facilitating the government rebate process with his digital quoting system and kept me up to date with email and phone.The installers were polite, neat and efficient and left zero mess. We had to have our switchboard updated in addition and this was organised to be done same day as install. The inspector came the afternoon of install and our system was up and running by the end of the day. All pretty seamless really. One of the fellas also helped me out with another small electrical job after they had finished the install. Thoroughly recommend.

Shopping for a solar system is daunting but Solar Quotes provided important information in a very digestible form. The recommendation of Traeger Solar proved to be significant. Aaron is easy and professional to deal with and his team did a great job. The install quality is first class and there was no damage to our tile roof. : ) The team were also great to deal with and completed everything we required. I could not recommend Solar Quotes or Traeger Solar enough. Many thanks for helping us navigate the solar minefield.

It was a delight to work with Aaron in having solar installed. The whole process went both smoothly and quickly. He provided an initial quote and then followed up with a visit to inspect the roof and fine tune the quote and solar system plans. I was particularly pleased that his design put panels across as all three possible aspects of the roof. I'm getting solar power early on the morning to evening which is great.The installation went smoothly and communication was great throughout regarding replacing roof tiles etc. The team did a great job and were very thorough and tidy throughout the entire process.The grid connection was organised and the inspector noted that Traegar Solar were known for their reliable installations. The cherry on the top of a great experience. I have already recommended them to friends.

We have chosen Traeger Solar, in part, based on internet reviews. It turned out to be a great choice.From quote to installation to follow-up it all went smoothly. On installation day the team arrived on time and completed the job in a few hours. They were clearly experienced, polite and cleaned up at the end of the job. It is now several months since the installation and the system is performing great. Our first electricity bill since the solar system installation has arrived - it was less then $ 30! Based on our experince we would definitely  recommend Traeger Solar for a solar system installation

We chose Traeger Solar after recommendation from a friend who had used them, and we were not disappointed.  A phone call to Aaron resulted in an appointment a few days later for an inspection of the site on the basis of which, and a review of our past electricity usage, he recommended a system to meet our current and future needs.  He fully and clearly explained the type of solar panel and inverter he would use, the installation process and how the rebates worked.  The visit was followed soon after with his quote which we found reasonable, so we accepted it.  Aaron helped us with the process of obtaining the government rebates and he and his team looked after the grid connection and approvals.  The installation was scheduled for early March but we got a call from Aaron that they could come on 5 Feb which suited us.  The installation took all day and throughout, Aaron and his team were polite and professional.  Any mess was cleared up.  The system works beautifully and we are very pleased with it.  The only issue we had was using the SolarEdge app for monitoring the production and usage of the solar power, which, for some reason, we weren't receiving the data, but Aaron helped to sort that out.  We have no hesitation in recommending Traegar Solar for the installation of a solar energy system.

Aaaron visited the property (as opposed to using google maps) which allowed us to discuss options which hadn't been suggested by others.All aspects of the install were proffesional, tidy, punctual and neatly finished.The install involved adding panels to an already existing system. This required integrating new and existing hardware and configuring microinverters.I've had the combined system for 6 months and and had no problems.

From the initial enquiry and first meeting Aaron, I was instantly confident, that we would use Traeger Solar, even before we had received the quote.  He was only one of two companies that actually came to inspect our house and although their quotes were not the cheapest we received, I am so glad that we went with one of their options.  Installation was completely trouble free and the team of four installers were very professional and worked extremely well, to get the job done.  We have been very impressed with all aspects of the process.  Very highly recommend Traeger Solar!

Aaron and his team did a great job installing my solar panel system.His customer service was first rate, as he was very responsive and communicated clearly.Aaron gave me good advice in designing the system as we worked out the best options.The solar edge app is fantastic to track your power generation and consumption.Overall, I’m very happy with my solar panel system and would highly recommend Aaron Traeger as an installer.

They came out and inspected the property and went through the options available us sent through the quotation promptly.They were a well organised team, that was on time and polite and cleaned up as they went.They completed the work ahead of time and organised the electrical inspection and grid connection .I would highly recommend them to anyone.
From the initial consultation, through quoting, to final installation, our experience with Traeger Solar was first class.

Aaron was polite and professional. Started the job early to keep to schedule when they were one man down. He was very patient and explained the timeline of approval a couple of times until I understood.The team were professional and tidied up afterwards. They even fixed a couple of tiles that were nowhere near the solar panels.

Responsive and prompt to my enquiry. Provided options for my new solar system. The proposal provided clear analysis of my electricity usage and how various sized systems would operate, with the savings clearly shown. I was reassured that the system could be upgraded and expanded in the future, giving me confidence in the quality and flexibility of the equipment.Aaron and his team were professional and quietly completed the work with minimal intrusion into our home. Their onsite liaison made the installation a breeze with their work area kept safe and clean.The team ensured that roof safety was in place and that electrical safety was adhered to. They paid attention to detail, ensured effective operation of the new system, and updated onsite information to meet the requirements of the Inspector.Looking forward to the benefits of the system in the years ahead.

Installer was efficient and professional.  Aaron answered all my queries and he came over to ensure system can be installed without any issues.  Booked the installation time and installer was on time and done an excellent job.I have recommended the installer to my neighbour and he will will use the same installer.
He came to our house to check it out and then gave us a quote.He was punctual and polite and cleaned up when finished.Customer service was great. Highly recommend him.
Everything was as promised, great communication and great delivery easy to deal with
Aaron listened well & was patient responding to questions during & after the quoting process. He recognized & anticipated needs. I would comfortably recommend his company’s services.

After being let down by the previous installer that came through SolarQuotes, Aaron was one of the respondents to our second attempt to get quotes. He was the only one that bothered to come to our residence and do a physical inspection. The price was competitive and the the information exactly what we needed. Installation went smoothly and the crew were very professional, cleaning up fully after themselves. The installation has just been certified and switched on yesterday. Thanks Aaron and crew. Recommended.

Fantastic service from Aaron and his crew. He took time on a Saturday to come out and quote for me, then promptly followed up to make sure I understood everything.You MUST include this company when you are enquiring about Solar.

We used Traeger Solar to supply and install a 15Kw solar system at our home. We found them to be very professional with excellent communication. The job was completed before time and everything was left neat and tidy.  We would certainly recommend Traeger Solar to anyone wanting a reliable supplier.

I spent 3 months talking to 9 installers trying to work out what I really wanted and what I needed to pay to achieve it.I settled on a system that provided best performance for shade, lower voltage and relabilituy that comes from enphase microinverters and a mid priced solar panel (in particular jinko all black 415watt panels, 28 in all).A number of installers were just trying to push overpriced panels or expensive installs, or were just plainly inflexible.I targeted a 8-12 year Return on Investment, not a 12-20 year Return on Investment. I just could not justify an extra eight to twelve thousand dollars for the same size systemI've seen a number of failed string systems over the years with family and friends and going down that track is just false economy in my opinion. I wanted a system to last at least 15 years and no burn out in 7 or 8.Aaron made the effort to come out on site promptly and listened to exactly what I wanted and where I wanted everything placed from a asthetics pespective. No visible ducting, Inverters in garage in the location we preferred. He quickly helped me understand where panels should go to maximize their output taking into account the indirect afternoon lightA detailed quote followed which was not the cheapest (but close to), but the best thought out. It was a tricky installation over 3 arraysYou're dealing with a real person who does the work and manages his own staff, not a distant presales person using a piece of software to guess things.He gave me an install date which he delivered on. He and his team were strict on safety. Attention  to detail which I really liked (like relocating the TV antenna and other solar lighting panels I had), all black moutings, and installing the panels to manufacturers spec which I pulled other installers up on). He also double checked the quality of all his guy's work, roof flashing and cabling. The guys cleaned up afterwards and were very professional.After 5.5 months the system has flawlessly delivered some 3.1 megwatts hours of clean energy and exceeded the estimates provided (by him and his competitors for the period apr 23 through sept 23)Would highly suggest having him on your short list to talk to when your solar journey comes time.
Great customer service from start to finish of job.Highly recommend Traeger Solar.
Great experience from Aaron and team  - from initial visit to final certificate. Good workmanship. Great admin support. System working great so far! Thanks Aaron and crew.

Aaron was a pleasure to deal with. Patiently answered all my questions over a few days, as I worked through various quotes. Good advice.When we went through with the job, he and his team came out shortly after approval - way faster than we were expecting. The job was tricky, and he consulted us throughout. He even moved our Inverter to the garage (the original inverter was on a North wall), despite the significant amount of effort it took to run the cabling. And, he did a fabulous job with replacing broken roof tiles - even sourcing the tiles for us. Top bloody servicing, well above and beyond.He arranged for another electrician to do the checks only a few days after, and we are delighted in our new system.Highly recommend Aaron and his time - hardworking, friendly, and taking pride in their work.

Aaron, like the other SolarQuotes recommendations, was very knowledgeable, friendly and patiently answered my questions. Quickly provided a 3 options for my consideration.The installation was scheduled in two weeks and the crew were extremely polite, tidy and installation completed in one day including ESV audit and approval!Aaron ensured the Fronius inverter linked to my wifi and explained how to use it.Follow up questions were also quickly answered.

Went back to Aaron after seeing the job he installed on my dad's house. Aaron is responsive. He gave several options and left it entirely up to me to research and decide.  He and his team showed up on time and did a very professional install. The independent inspector also rates Aaron's work very highly. Aaron arrange all paperwork with the electricity distributor and supplier. System was up and running in 2 weeks (slightly delayed because of inspection). Meter was reconfigured for feed-in few weeks after that. All in all a hassle free process.Highly recommended.I'll go back to Aaron for the battery install.
Very responsive, friendly and his staff are helpful. They are very professional.

No question was too stupid for Aaron when we were trying to make a decision. He is calm and rational, helpful and knowledgeable - and because our install  was a bit tricky, a great lateral thinker for achieving an outcome we're very pleased with. The install was (actually, IS as they're on the roof now!) very well planned, with a friendly and efficient team.He has assured me that he'll take care of forwarding on all the relevant installation certificates to complete the process with Ausnet... and given our history with him to date, I have no reason to doubt that tis will occur! Needless to say, I feel confident in recommending his services to any other local "wanna be PVs" I speak to.

Traeger Solar installed an 11.22kw solar system at our previous home in November 2019, comprising 34 LG (330w) panels with Enphase micro inverters.This performed flawlessly during our stay there.Traegar Solar has now installed an 11.88kw solar system at our current home (May 2023), comprising 27 Jinko (440w) Tiger Neo N-type 54HL4-(V) panels with SolarEdge S440 power optimisers and a SolarEdge Energy Hub SE10000H-AUS3MBX14.As a returning customer, I highly recommend Traeger Solar:Excellent punctual, professional service & a quality installation.

Just had a seamless experience with Aaron and his team. He was the only installer to visit our property. This allowed us to ask questions relevant to our home.  Aaron has a pleasant manner and obviously very knowledgeable in his field. Installation went ahead as advised and without incident. I have already recommended his company to a friend.

Sales / quoting process was simple and every detail well explained.Installation was best we have experienced. The team arrived on time and started work immediately.Discussed and agreed positioning of panels and inverter. Interaction with members was always friendly and mutually respectful. The team members cleaned up parts if the site durIng the installation and replaced all items they were required to move at the start.A trouble free installation. The only requirement on us was to initially make the decision to proceed. From that point it was a simple process . Found out later on the day that this was the company used to instal the system at my son’s house a few months ago. Would recommend Traegar Solar to anyone.

I used solar quotes to find Traegar solar and was very happy with the process.  They were the most knowledgeable company that quoted, helping answer some technical questions and ensuring the system was right for my specific situation (ie not just a cookie cutter approach) which I appreciated.  Also the quote was very competitive, so overall it was excellent service with good price.

We began our solar journey more than a year ago. Building delays, Covid etc slowed us down. Traeger Solar stayed in touch and when the time finally arrived, so did they. Aaron review our original array and offered a technical update to the latest available. The original quote barely changed. The team arrived early, worked quickly and completed the job a day short of expected. We hardly noticed their presence. A clear explanation of how it works with an offer of 'any queries, any problems, call us anytime!'. Friendly and clearly very competent, the boys left the site tidier than they found it! Highly recommend.
We had a great experience with Traeger, who were super helpful in selection of the system and the panels we wanted.

We were building a new home and asked to provide a quote at lock up stage.  Aaron came to site and nothing was a problem.  He went through the best system for the site.  The system was installed yesterday.  Aaron and his crew just know their stuff and what stood out was how professional was in delivering a great product.  Would highly recommend.

I have shading issues on my property and contacted Aaron after receiving three other solar panel installation quotes which had been generated simply from a satellite image of my property and therefore did not take in to account the shade issues. Aaron came out to inspect my property and discuss alternative solutions for managing the shade issues before submitting a quote. Consequently, I ended up with a different and much more effective solution to the other three proposals. This was all done in a very timely manner. The installation itself went extremely smoothly and Aaron's team was first class. Aaron's communication was excellent and he was very happy to provide quick, clear responses to any questions I had. I would thoroughly recommend his services.

Aaron and the team were fantastic from start to finish. Highly professional, clear, efficient and thorough. I was impressed with their attention to detail and making sure that the design and install was the best for our particular situation.
